rules: protocol adapter validates issuer/audience/signature/nonce/time before this port
mapped active local account and ready authorization projection before local session
no automatic account merge by email, display name or mutable employee alias
no JIT authority inferred from claims
ports.candidate_provider: one chosen auth-code profile with PKCE S256; actual enterprise protocol remains unconfirmed

ports.subject: mapped external subject
ports.effect: local disable cannot be reversed by central active; central disable denies before projection

ports.subject: mapped external subject
ports.effect: proven complete empty set revokes managed roles; unknown dependencies remain held

ports.subject: external role identifier
ports.effect: registered managed resources only; no external role becomes built-in superadmin

feed_envelope.revision: positive integer from source, not arrival time
feed_envelope.complete: synthetic producer attestation for one object/set; not inferred from SCIM pagination
feed_envelope.caller_context: authenticated adapter identity supplied out of band; fixture string is harness authority only
feed_envelope.duplicate_receipt: same event/content is idempotent; equal source revision/content with a new transport event ID aliases original receipt; conflicting content rejects

exit_contract.approval_binding: SHA256 of canonical JSON plan using sort_keys and compact separators; trusted harness approval only, not an approval service
current_rechecks: all local subjects known and capabilities registered
exit_contract.effect: replace local permissions with explicitly approved mapping only; no automatic restoration of pre-takeover grants

optional_scim_mapping.use: optional directory adapter for selected user/group facts; no requirement to implement a general SCIM server
optional_scim_mapping.identity: SCIM id/externalId and OIDC issuer+subject require an explicit approved mapping; never assume equality
optional_scim_mapping.governance: role/resource vocabulary, source version, authoritative completeness and effect acknowledgement need a separate provider contract
optional_scim_mapping.pagination: RFC7644 pagination is not a stable snapshot; list metadata does not prove absence/deletion
optional_scim_mapping.transport: SCIM HTTP methods remain inside adapter; these ports do not change the core GET/POST API convention

audit.source_event_ref: short SHA256 projection, not raw message body
